Name: Horror Rain (CP) - Blood Rain or Acid Rain
Author: LorSnore
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever wanted the apocalypse to rain down on Stardew Valley? Well now it can!* Bring about cursed blood rain or toxic acid rain!
[/size] ﻿*Other plague-like features such as locusts not included

[size=3]Replaces the rain texture through Content Patcher
[list]
[*]Configurable to Blood or Acid rain in the config.json file after running the mod once, default Blood
[/list][/size]
The acid rain is a bit hard to see against vanilla color grass, but I didn't want to make it more neon than it already was so ﻿¯\_(ツ)_/¯
